items.body: The supplier retrieve endpoint's per-passenger ancillary itemization undercounts any ancillary code repeated for that passenger (two legs of one direction, or two directions of a round trip) — e.g. a Meal charged on 2 legs at 200 EGP/leg is itemized as only 400 INR instead of 800 INR. The booking-level aggregate total remains correct in every case observed, so no customer-facing amount is wrong; only a per-passenger breakdown consumer would be misled. Reproduced on 5 independent bookings (PNRs YSTPMB, Y1ZVFF, Z33F4Z, P6MVJA, MSK5XB, S13GWS); confirmed absent on 2 control bookings with no repeated code.

fields.label: Suspected Component
fields.value: NDC integration service Retrieve mapping — passengerAncillaries itemization step

items.body: Wallet History Report shows Start/End Balance rows under the 'Debit' column while the actual money-out booking transaction appears under 'Credit' — the inverse of standard accounting convention. The figures themselves are correct in every booking checked; only the column placement is in question. The reviewer was asked directly and explicitly chose to defer the decision, so this case stays Inconclusive rather than being forced to Passed or Failed.

sections.title: Known Limitations
blocks: Statement report (TC-ANC-026) could not be verified this pass — a confirmed defect (FINDING-012) makes it return zero rows on both channels; it is held Excluded until fixed.

A direct live re-read of the post-booking Portal wallet balance widget was not captured for TC-ANC-015 — a transient network dropout interrupted a second attempt; the Total Due to NDC report's exact-match figure was used as equivalent evidence instead.
A cosmetic label glitch on the Bundle Services field ('[Xtra Pack', a stray unmatched bracket) was observed once during TC-ANC-002 — Low severity, display-only, no effect on data or amounts.

items: Fix the NDC integration service's Retrieve mapping so a repeated ancillary code itemizes correctly per occurrence, then re-execute TC-ANC-022.
Obtain the deferred product decision on Wallet History's Debit/Credit labeling, then re-execute TC-ANC-027 to a definite outcome.
Fix FINDING-012 (Statement report), move TC-ANC-026's Review to Approved, then execute it.
Low priority: fix the stray '[' in the Bundle Services label rendering.
